author_note: Read only the 13 workflow contracts in .worktrees/netzoo-core-p0-run/workflows/*.yaml and scripts/workflow_registry.py; nothing else was opened and the assistant was not run. Each gold was decided from the contract text quoted in its evidence: do = a result the named or fitting workflow produces with inputs, counts and settings inside its stated limits (including boundary values such as lambda in {0, 1}, lam = 1, gamma = 0, exactly three samples, kmax equal to the sample count, and a LIONESS-DRAGON run of 17,970,000 values under the 20,000,000 limit); dont = a result no workflow produces or one contract condition violated (three layers, unexposed GIRAFFE settings, unregistered LIONESS-OTTER, parquet output, causal claims, genes not exceeding samples, two samples, TF-only activity, the value limit, kmax above samples, raw expression into CONDOR, OTTER GPU); ask = the user's own stated uncertainty or conflict about one fact that a request-level limit or an output difference decides; vague = no concrete result named. LIONESS-DRAGON value counts use n(n-1)/2 feature pairs over both layers times samples. Evidence quotes are verbatim YAML; quotes spanning several YAML lines are given with line breaks and indentation collapsed to single spaces.
